description: This file implements a Redis-based semantic cache for LiteLLM, providing classes and methods for storing and retrieving semantically similar responses using vector embeddings and Redis as a backend.

classes.name: RedisSemanticCache
classes.description: A class providing semantic caching functionality backed by Redis, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous operations, with methods for setting, getting, and indexing cache entries based on semantic similarity.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the RedisSemanticCache with configuration parameters, setting up Redis connection and vectorizer.

methods.name: _get_ttl
methods.description: Retrieves the TTL (time-to-live) value for cache entries from kwargs.

methods.name: _get_embedding
methods.description: Generates an embedding vector for a prompt using the configured embedding model.

methods.name: _get_cache_logic
methods.description: Processes cached responses for use, decoding bytes and parsing JSON or literals.

methods.name: set_cache
methods.description: Stores a response in the semantic cache associated with a prompt derived from messages.

methods.name: get_cache
methods.description: Retrieves a semantically similar cached response based on prompt messages.

methods.name: _get_async_embedding
methods.description: Asynchronously generates an embedding vector for a prompt, possibly routing through a proxy.

methods.name: async_set_cache
methods.description: Asynchronously stores a response in the semantic cache.

methods.name: async_get_cache
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a semantically similar cached response.

methods.name: _index_info
methods.description: Fetches information about the Redis index asynchronously.

methods.name: async_set_cache_pipeline
methods.description: Stores multiple cache entries asynchronously in a pipeline.
